Namespace OnixRuntime.Api.Aura

Classes

AuraBackendCapabilities

Exposes the hardware capabilities of a graphics backend, including per-format support flags and maximum resource binding counts. Retrieve this via Capabilities.

AuraBackendCapabilities.PerFormat

Describes GPU support flags for a single AuraColorFormat.

AuraColorFormatExtensions

Extensions for the AuraColorFormat enum.

AuraResourcePointer

Holds an Aura resource reference.

IAuraBackend

The main graphics backend interface. Manages the GPU device, resource creation, pipeline state, and rendering commands. Analogous to the combination of ID3D11Device and ID3D11DeviceContext in Direct3D 11. Create one via CreateBackend().

IAuraBackendCreator

Factory for creating IAuraBackend instances. Allows querying available graphics adapters and selecting an API version before creating the backend. Obtain one via the static factory methods such as CreateD3d12() or CreateD3d11().

IAuraBuffer

Represents a GPU buffer resource.

IAuraGraphicsAdapter

Represents a physical or virtual graphics adapter (GPU) available on the system. Provides access to adapter properties such as memory sizes, hardware identifiers, and supported API versions.

IAuraWindow

Represents a native OS window. Provides control over window state, size, position, and appearance, as well as integration with the graphics backend for rendering.

IBlendState

Represents an instance of a BlendState. This dictates how blending will occur.

IDepthStencilBuffer

Represents a depth stencil buffer resource, containing the depth and stencil buffers depending on format.

IDepthStencilState

Represents an instance of a depth stencil state. This dictates how the depth buffer and stencil buffers are handled.

IPipelineSnapshot

A captured snapshot of the graphics pipeline state that can be restored later, useful for preserving and recovering render state around third-party hooks or interop scenarios. Obtain one via TakeSnapshot(bool, bool, bool, bool).

IRasterizerState

Represents an instance of a rasterizer state. This dictates how pixels are created out of geometry.

IRenderTarget

Represents a render target resource instance, which is a texture that can be rendered to during rendering operations. A render target allows you to draw graphics onto a texture, enabling techniques such as off-screen rendering, post-processing effects, and dynamic texture generation.

ISampler

Represents a texture sampler resource instance, which defines how textures are sampled during rendering operations, including filtering, addressing modes, and other sampling parameters.

IShaderInputLayout

Represents an instance of a shader input layout, which defines how vertex data is organized and accessed by the GPU when rendering. It encapsulates the configuration of vertex attributes, including their formats, semantic names, and input slots. The shader input layout is essential for ensuring that the vertex data is correctly interpreted by the shader programs during rendering operations.

IShaderProgram

Represents a shader, which contains the Vertex Shader, Pixel Shader and other kinds potentially.

ITexture

Represents an aura texture.

ShaderInputLayoutDesc

Represents a collection that describes the layout of input elements for a shader. Provides methods to define, modify, and enumerate the input elements used by a shader program.

ShaderInputLayoutDesc.Storage

Represents a single element in the shader input layout description. It contains the format type, semantic name, slot, and whether it's per-instance data.

Structs

AuraBufferDesc

Describes a buffer resource, including its size, usage, and other properties that control how the buffer is created and used in graphics applications.

AuraSupportedAdapterApi

Describes a graphics API version supported by an IAuraGraphicsAdapter, including whether the implementation is software-based and its version identifier.

BlendStateDesc

Describes the blend state configuration for a set of render targets, including blending, logic operations, and color write masks. Used to control how pixel colors are combined during rendering.

BlendStateDesc.BlendTarget

Represents a render target blend description since all 8 render targets can have their own individual blend parameters.

DepthStencilBufferDesc

Describes the configuration for a depth-stencil buffer.

DepthStencilStateDesc

The description of the depth-stencil state, which controls how depth testing and stencil testing are performed during rendering.

FullScreenDisplayMode

Describes a display mode including resolution and refresh rate. Used when switching to exclusive fullscreen or querying supported modes.

MsaaDesc

Describes the parameters used to control multisample anti-aliasing (MSAA) settings for textures, including the number of samples and quality level.

RasterizerStateDesc

Describes how the rasterizer should be configured.

RenderTargetDesc

Describes the configuration for a render target.

SamplerDesc

Describes the parameters used to control how textures are sampled in rendering operations, including filtering, addressing modes, level-of-detail bias, and comparison functions.

TextureDesc

Describes properties and configuration of a texture resource.

Enums

AuraColorFormat

Defines pixel formats for textures, render targets, and swap chains.

AuraDepthStencilFormat

Defines formats for depth and stencil buffers used in rendering.

AuraFormatType

The type of format to use for data serialization or vertex attributes. Formats starting with 'N' mean Normalized (values are scaled between 0.0f-1.0f or -1.0f-1.0f within the entire bit length min/max). Formats starting with 'U' mean Unsigned (only positive numbers, e.g., 0 to Max). Formats starting with 'S' mean Signed (allow negative numbers, e.g., Min to Max).

AuraPresentResult

Represents the result of presenting a frame on a swap chain. That's usually where you'll be alerted of any major error.

AuraSamplerAddressMode

Defines how texture coordinates outside the [0,1] range are handled during sampling.

AuraSamplerFilterType

Defines the filtering mode used when sampling a texture.

BlendLogicOperation

Defines logic operations for pixel blending using bitwise boolean calculations.

BlendOperation

Defines the operation used to combine source and destination colors/alphas during blending.

BlendType

Defines blending factors used in the pixel shader output merger stage.

BufferBindUsage

Defines the usage flags for binding buffer resources to the graphics pipeline.

CullMode

Defines which faces of a primitive are culled during rasterization.

FillMode

Defines how the interior of primitives is rasterized.

FullScreenState

Defines the fullscreen state of a window.

PrimitiveTopology

Defines the topology of primitives to be rendered by the graphics pipeline.

SamplerDesc.ComparisonFuncs

Defines comparison functions for depth and stencil buffer tests.

ShaderProgramKind

Defines the shader language and profile version used for compiling graphics programs.

StencilComparisonFunc

Defines comparison functions for stencil buffer testing.

StencilOperation

Defines operations applied to the stencil buffer value during rendering.
